dedupe_keys.name: data set from fischertechnik smart factory model at university of st gallen custom python configuration

description: Ronny Seiger publishes approximately sixty minutes of IoT and workflow observations from the St.Gallen Fischertechnik smart factory under custom Python control. The free Zenodo release uses CC BY 4.0 and includes MQTT-derived JSON text, Camunda activity and process-instance logs, and three BPMN process definitions. Python Flask services connect process execution to production stations. These paired records can calibrate activity sequences and device-to-workflow timing in manufacturing simulations. Related G6 dataset data-stgallen-factory-standard-mqtt-logs records a different control configuration, while data-stgallen-factory-six-process-iot-event-logs covers an earlier six-instance experiment. The filename identifies a February 2023 session, not prolonged factory operation. Event alignment, sensor completeness and scale transfer remain uncertain. Executable BPMN definitions still require the corresponding control services and hardware interfaces. No records were downloaded, services deployed or throughput claims tested.
